stage0051a_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What's wrong, bro?
　You're down more than usual today.」

stage0051a_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Looks like that old sickness flared up again...」

stage0051a_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Quit it.
　You're souring the drink.」

stage0051a_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Tell me...
　You know something, don't you?」

stage0051a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Then let me ask, if I told you 'you're a dog'...
　would that satisfy you?」

stage0051a_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Knowing the truth won't do you any good.
　Forget it and live in a dream instead.
　Nice and hazy, nice and soft.」

stage0051a_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Sheesh... what a serious guy...」

stage0051a_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Man, the wind's blowing in a bad direction.
　It's souring a perfectly good drink...」

stage0051a_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「...I've been waiting.
　I always knew you'd come, someday.」

stage0051a_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「Looks like you've forgotten my request as well...」

stage0051a_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A request...?
　You... know something about me?」

stage0051a_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「There's no use telling you that, not as you are now.」

stage0051a_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Tell me!
　Who am I!」

stage0051a_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「Don't get rough with an old man.」

stage0051a_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「Looks like it'll still take some time...」

stage0051a_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「...Though time means nothing in this city...」

stage0051a_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「But the 12,000-year cycle is about to close...
　No... maybe it's 120,000,000 years.」

stage0051a_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「You mean it doesn't matter to you?」

stage0051a_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「No need to let it trouble you.
　That's your role, and it's what this city means.」

stage0051a_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「Besides, he might be happier
　not knowing anything at all.」

stage0051a_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Because the $$烙印$$ was carved into him,
　he wanders, bound by half-formed memories...」

stage0051a_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「I didn't want to see him like that...」

stage0051a_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「Then let's leave it to fate.
　But if he ever remembers his own role...」

stage0051a_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「I'll give him this book.」

stage0051a_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「Until that time comes, I want you to keep this safe.」

stage0051a_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「You don't need to read it.
　Especially not the last chapter I just added.」

stage0051a_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「That's right.
　I wanted to leave something behind, in my own way...」

stage0051a_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$くらら$$
「No good...
　We can't get even a single lead on him.」

stage0051a_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That man in the black suit and coat...
　No one seems to have seen him these past few days.」

stage0051a_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「If even $$くらら$$, our narcotics investigator, and
　$$ＩＣＰＯ$$'s $$正太郎$$ can't find him, we're stumped.」

stage0051a_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「What about $$朔哉$$, our former homeless guy?
　Any idea where he might stop by?」

stage0051a_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Guys like that,
　they look like they live free and easy,
　but they've got their turf.」

stage0051a_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$朔哉$$
「If he's not even within his usual range,
　this might be bad news...」

stage0051a_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't scare us like that, $$朔哉$$!
　That man in black might be the key
　to getting us out of here!」

stage0051a_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Outside the city, it's nothing but wasteland and ruins.
　There's no doubt this is a different world
　from the one we came from.」

stage0051a_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I hate this.
　Wasting time
　in a world that makes no sense...!」

stage0051a_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't space out on us.
　If you've got a fever, go back to the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.」

stage0051a_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Funny thing, me and $$エイーダ$$ too.」

stage0051a_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「More like feverish...
　Like there's heat deep inside me...」

stage0051a_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So basically, all of Team D's the same.」

stage0051a_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Did everyone catch a cold or something?」

stage0051a_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アスカ$$
「H-hey...!
　Don't go giving it to us!」

stage0051a_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$葵$$
「It's fine, $$アスカ$$...
　This isn't some kind of sickness.」

stage0051a_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Something welling up from somewhere deeper...」

stage0051a_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$葵$$
「Yeah... enough to make you want to just give in to it.」

stage0051a_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Everyone... this is kind of scary...」

stage0051a_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I-I feel like I'm about to get eaten...?」

stage0051a_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why are you... panicking, $$シンジ$$?」

stage0051a_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$くらら$$
「Ugh... I really can't explain it...」

stage0051a_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Quit talking nonsense
　and hurry up and find that man in black!」

stage0051a_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$くらら$$
「Got it, $$葵$$.
　Let's meet up later.」

stage0051a_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$葵$$
（What is this...
　I feel like something's about to start moving...）

stage0051a_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
???
「Do you want to know what comes next?」

stage0051a_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「That's right...
　Your awakening as the start sets the gears turning,
　and in time, it leads to the truth...」

stage0051a_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「$$シュバルツバルト$$...」

stage0051a_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「One who seeks the truth in this fabricated world...!
　That's right! Just like all of you!」

stage0051a_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$n
「...So then, $$ノーマン$$,
　you have no worries about your life now?」

stage0051a_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Yes.
　I take pride in my work as a butler.」

stage0051a_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$n
「You've come to accept not having your memories?」

stage0051a_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「It's not that I have no complaints at all,
　but memories are a thing of the past, after all.」

stage0051a_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「The past won't change no matter what,
　so there's no point dwelling on it.
　What matters is the present and what's ahead.」

stage0051a_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Master $n... if there's a past that haunts you,
　you need to put it to rest.」

stage0051a_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「One such path is forgetting... to simply let go.」

stage0051a_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「I understand.
　If it's something you cannot forget, face it head-on,
　and settle it from there.」

stage0051a_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$n
「...Thank you.
　Thanks to you, $$ノーマン$$, I... I've clearly
　remembered what I need to do.」

stage0051a_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「I'm honored to have been of help.
　...Well then, it's about time,
　so I'll be taking my leave.」

stage0051a_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$n
「Are you going back to a house no one returns to?」

stage0051a_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「It is my duty to keep things ready
　for whenever my master returns.
　And there's more to do besides preparing dinner.」

stage0051a_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「More importantly, are you sure it's alright?
　I hear Master $n is in the middle of work too.」

stage0051a_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$n
「I'll do my best from here on.
　...I want to know more about this city, after all.」

stage0051a_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Then I'll take my leave.
　I pray for your success and safety.」

stage0051a_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Can't even speak, out of fear?
　No wonder.」

stage0051a_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Then let me introduce myself before you ask.」

stage0051a_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「My name is $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.
　Geminis' commander, and the man you're after.」

stage0051a_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You'd love to lunge at me, huh...
　But you can't, not with legs shaking like that.」

stage0051a_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「W-well, relax.
　I just came to say hello today.」

stage0051a_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Oh... you can still talk? Well done.
　As a reward, I'll tell you just one thing.」

stage0051a_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Your world, you know...
　it's the same as this Paradigm City.」

stage0051a_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「See ya.
　We'll meet again, Imitation.」

stage0051a_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$シン$$
「They went and did as they pleased again...!」

stage0051a_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... ever since that last battle,
　they seemed to be troubled...」

stage0051a_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That bloodied eyes thing, is it...」

stage0051a_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$桂$$
「Does this Paradigm City have something to do
　with that angel they're chasing?」

stage0051a_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know...
　I think $n's looking into that, but...」

stage0051a_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If that angel really is here,
　it would explain why we got sent
　to Paradigm City, but...」

stage0051a_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$シン$$
「In the end, we still don't know
　who $$アドヴェント$$ is, or what Geminis will do...」

stage0051a_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$キラ$$
「First, let's find the black-clad man
　$$竜馬$$ and the others saw. That's our only lead.」

stage0051a_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Do you want to see him that badly?」

stage0051a_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「So you really have forgotten.
　Both me, and him...」

stage0051a_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$桂$$
「Nice line, but we've never met.
　There's no way I'd forget
　a beauty like you.」

stage0051a_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you know the man we're after?」

stage0051a_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Yes... I know him very well.」

stage0051a_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Before that, tell me.
　What do you intend to do with him?」

stage0051a_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$キラ$$
「Even if you ask what we intend...」

stage0051a_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Hahahaha!
　How pitiful, you $$烙印$$-bearers!」

stage0051a_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「It's been a while, everyone.
　Though you're all lost in the fog of oblivion now.」

stage0051a_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Then let me introduce myself again.
　I am $$シュバルツバルト$$... a seeker of truth.」

stage0051a_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Even you're showing up now...」

stage0051a_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「That's right, Miss $$エンジェル$$.
　All of this, too, is because of your doubt.」

stage0051a_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「That doubt drew them here,
　and blurred that man's memory at the same time!
　Behold!」

stage0051a_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「What are you people...
　Do you know... who I am...!?」

stage0051a_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Tell me!
　Who am I!?
　What is this watch with no face!?」

stage0051a_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「That is your lost power...
　and your lost time...」

stage0051a_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Very well!
　Then let me show the truth to you...
　and to those who seek you!」

stage0051a_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Hahaha, seems you can't handle it!
　Not while that emotion lives inside you!」

stage0051a_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「This... feeling I have right now...
　A raw, illogical fear I don't want to admit...」

stage0051a_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「So you'll live on, looking away from it...」

stage0051a_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「That's not the you I wanted to see...」

stage0051a_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Oh... so there's a fragment-bearer among you too.」

stage0051a_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Do you mean to say you can overcome fear?」

stage0051a_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Did you hear that!
　This kid claims to be ready for the truth!」

stage0051a_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Don't torment him... or me, any more!」

stage0051a_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$n
「Even if it hurts, some things you can't run from...!
　I know that for a fact!」

stage0051a_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$n
「Are you really fine staying like this!?
　Not knowing anything, dressed in rags,
　wandering the streets forever, is that what you want!?」

stage0051a_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「No...
　A request I take on... I always see it through...」

stage0051a_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「To do that... I must...
　overcome every hardship there is...
　That is my... pride...」

stage0051a_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And now, the one I must fight
　is the fear inside me I've always feared...」

stage0051a_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I never once admitted it existed.
　I pretended not to see the enemy I should fight...!」

stage0051a_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$」

stage0051a_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$...!?」

stage0051a_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$桂$$
「He was a stubborn, cranky guy, but...」

stage0051a_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$キラ$$
「He was a strong man, proud of his work...」

stage0051a_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「That's right!
　You all should know it!」

stage0051a_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You called me $$ロジャー・スミス$$, $$ドロシー#240$$.
　So it's fine for me to play $$ロジャー・スミス$$?」

stage0051a_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「Play?
　You are no actor, $$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

stage0051a_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's right.
　$$Ｒ．ドロシー・ウェインライト$$」

stage0051a_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「As long as you call me that,
　I am $$ロジャー・スミス$$!!」

stage0051a_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Heh... so you got over your fear enough to move, huh.」

stage0051a_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Recklessness born of youth, how scary.」

stage0051a_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that's the man $n was after!」

stage0051a_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well, well, everyone from $c...
　all gathered together, how nice.」

stage0051a_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I hear my subordinate $$アンナロッタ$$ troubled you.」

stage0051a_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's right.
　I'm Geminis' commander... $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.
　A pleasure to make your acquaintance.」

stage0051a_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This is the one who started the Earth-colony war...!」

stage0051a_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't screw with us!
　Why did you do something like that!?」

stage0051a_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If I had to say, boredom?」

stage0051a_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$刹那$$
「What kind of man are you!」

stage0051a_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$シモン$$
「Your bluff ends here!
　Don't think you can outrun this many of us!」

stage0051a_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hold on a second...!
　Bit much, heroes ganging up on just one guy!」

stage0051a_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$宗介$$
「I will not indulge your idle chatter.」

stage0051a_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Surround him!
　We attack all at once!」

stage0051a_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$デュオ$$
「$$ミシェル$$, $$クルツ$$, $$ロックオン$$!
　Cover us!!」

stage0051a_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Shut it!
　You've earned every bit of this!」

stage0051a_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「What is this...!?
　My body... it won't move...!」

stage0051a_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$n
「The anger inside me is rapidly fading away...」

stage0051a_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's the opposite will hidden deep in your hearts.
　Everyone carries fear behind anger, and tears
　behind a smile.」

stage0051a_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'm the one who can make that hidden will
　surface, that's all.」

stage0051a_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't tell me, with this power...!?」

stage0051a_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Bingo.
　I used this on the ones calling for peace
　between Earth and the colonies, too」

stage0051a_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Even folks overflowing with humanitarian spirit,
　have feelings inside that go against it...
　Amplify those, and you get results like that」

stage0051a_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's the same logic as light and shadow.
　...Brighter light, darker shadow...
　That's why their anger got so ferocious」

stage0051a_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「So that's... the truth behind the riots...!」

stage0051a_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Impressive, impressive.
　Even my power can't snuff out your anger!」

stage0051a_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Is it that your will is strong,
　or that I'm still lacking...?
　Guess it's probably both」

stage0051a_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$葵$$
「No way... no way I'd lose to something like this!!」

stage0051a_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Quite the roar.
　Guess that's what waking your beast blood does」

stage0051a_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So that's one seal broken, then...
　Guess I miscalculated on that one」

stage0051a_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But, too baaad.
　Your world's history ends in three months」

stage0051a_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$タケル$$
「Are you talking about the end of humanity's history!?」

stage0051a_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$n
「Answer me, $$ガドライト$$!
　What's going on!?」

stage0051a_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Already dropping formalities, huh...
　Pretty frank of you, kid」

stage0051a_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「As a memento of our meeting,
　I'll let you in on it」

stage0051a_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The flow of absolute time for life in your world
　will slow, then stop completely in three months」

stage0051a_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Clocks may tick on, but the world's time stays still...
　The sun may rise and set, the seasons may pass,
　but absolute time itself won't flow」

stage0051a_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's right.
　Same as this Paradigm City.
　No aging there, but no birth either」

stage0051a_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What meaning is there in a world like that!」

stage0051a_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I suppose so.
　A world that just maintains itself stagnates slowly,
　and rots away in time」

stage0051a_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Truly an eternal prisoner locked in time's own cell.
　There's no such thing as a future」

stage0051a_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is this the effect of the $$新世時空震動$$...!?」

stage0051a_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't tell me, the one who caused that $$時空震動$$...!」

stage0051a_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll leave that to your imagination」

stage0051a_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$バナージ$$
「A world where every possibility is denied...
　how could that ever be acceptable!」

stage0051a_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Yeah.
　I think so too」

stage0051a_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Watching you get strangled slow, like with silk floss,
　was just too pitiful to watch」

stage0051a_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's why we
　lit the fuse, so you Earthlings
　could hurry up and go extinct!」

stage0051a_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Two more things in common with Paradigm City, too.
　You've probably noticed, you all, or rather,
　everyone worldwide, have had memories tampered with」

stage0051a_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Force a memory, and you get a weird headache, right?
　That's exactly what that was」

stage0051a_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So that's why I'd forgotten all about
　Mr. $$ロジャー$$ and the others!」

stage0051a_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$葵$$
「Then is that why the seniors are gone from this world!?」

stage0051a_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's right!
　I rearranged things to suit myself!」

stage0051a_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Then, the reason we got transported here...!?」

stage0051a_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Probably just what you'd expect」

stage0051a_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$桂$$
「I don't like this...!
　Tampering with memories on a whim, and worse,
　doing as you please with the world too!」

stage0051a_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Getting angry at me is misguided.
　If anything, you all got lucky」

stage0051a_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What's more,
　it was Earthlings themselves who invited this」

stage0051a_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「What do you mean by that!?」

stage0051a_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Too bad!
　Time's about up」

stage0051a_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「My power won't hold out much longer against you all」

stage0051a_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「See ya, $F.
　I'm looking forward to the day we meet again」

stage0051a_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「No... this is probably that person's doing」

stage0051a_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「See ya, $c.
　Next time, I might just get serious」
